proposed_facts.reason: Independently read every cited range. TagFail tests only animation exhaustion. Recovery sets the remembered state to Wait2_1, selects the helper entering Wait1_2, and stores the attribute-derived destination and callback. Collision later invokes that callback when the arrival scalar is zero. This corrects the unsupported numeric-389 inference.

Canonical caller and callee confirm command clearing before handoff, explicit ThrownMasterHand entry despite the callee's original name, ignored second parameter, reciprocal-pointer dereference and accessory callback installation. The subsequent null check, ordered helper calls, neg1 multiplication and independent cleanup block match the proposal.

The event block precedes an independent exit block, permitting same-invocation handoff and recovery. Clearing the command establishes per-arming behavior without proving lifetime uniqueness. The initial call requires valid object relationships before the later null check. Squeeze omits the second boss predicate used by RockPaper and Grab, and the recovery implementation confirms named Wait1_2.
